methodology.fareProduct: Simulated one-adult, one-way, nonstop economy INR total; no real offers
methodology.index: Fixed route-airline-departure-band basket observed on at least 96% of dates; exact 21-day booking horizon; missing quotes carried forward up to 3 days and disclosed
methodology.aggregation: Geometric mean of cell price relatives per directional route; arithmetic route average weighted by assumed daily service count
methodology.base: First collection date = 100; same base across all 730 dates
methodology.exclusions: Only AVAILABLE simulated INR fares enter fare medians. SOLD_OUT, NO_OFFER and simulated failures are excluded from price calculations but retained in the quality audit. Basket cells lacking a fresh quote use the last observed median for at most 3 days; longer gaps would fail basket selection.
methodology.leadTime: Median available fares at 1, 7, 14, 21, 30 and 45 days before the same completed simulated departures in the last 45-day cohort; only departures with all six horizons are included
methodology.event: Affected travel-date 21-day quotes compared with the preceding 7 travel dates; descriptive scenario, not a causal estimate
methodology.quality: One simulated generator is the sole source. Candidate anomalies are fresh matched-cell medians more than 80% above or below the trailing 28-date median (minimum 14 dates); they are flagged, not excluded. Research index requires all 24 routes, at least 90% available attempts, and no more than 5% carried basket cells. Simulation is never eligible as an official published index.
methodology.limitations: No live fares, verified schedules, passenger weights, official CPI status, real collection failures or validated forecast accuracy
